title:
[P2.15d-i-pre-budget] Two-phase budget commitment for approval.decide_intent (ruling A): decide-time commitment digest from one shared material builder, activation binds back</title>
<parameter name="priority">HIGH
description:
FILED per governor ruling comment-87ad84c1 on task-ba102165 (17:35Z): BUDGET_REF fork option (A) TWO-PHASE COMMITMENT RESOLVED AT ACTIVATION; (B)/(C) rejected outright as attestation-changing. Fourth missing fact at the landed approval.decide_intent seam (approval-intent.ts:194-197, APPROVAL_MISSING_FACT_CODES[3] = APPROVAL_INTENT_BUDGET_REF_UNAVAILABLE @ DAEMON_APPROVAL_INTENT).

THE ORDERING PROBLEM, MEASURED AT HEAD 24ac4ae9: `ApprovalDecisionRecord.budgetRef` is required (packages/core/src/policy/approval-contract.ts:49; roster approval-validation.ts:25/:33, validHex64). The budget root digest is minted AT ACTIVATION: approval-activation.ts:116 `budgetRootFor` -> `resolveApprovalBudgetRoot(store, GenesisLegInput{ approvedRun{runBinding, verifiedGraphRevisionRef}, context{commandId, correlationId, decidedAt, principalId}, goalRef, projectId })` (budget/budget-genesis-leg.ts:185) -> `buildGenesisBudgetLeg` (:88) -> `authorizeBudgetRoot(store, {amounts: GENESIS_AMOUNTS, context, goalRef, projectId}, commit, genesisBudgetBindingPort(approvedRun))` whose `digest` is "the writer's OWN canonical digest over the record it would commit" (:70); :168-170 refuses BOOTSTRAP_BUDGET_HASH_MISMATCH @ DAEMON_PREREQUISITE when a caller's claimed budgetHash disagrees; :176 persists it; graph-activation-service.ts:128/:181-192 mirrors it. The digest's material includes the ACTIVATION envelope (context), which does not exist at decide time.

DELIVER (A): at decide time the record's `budgetRef` is a COMMITMENT digest over the budget material visible then — goalRef, projectId, approvedRun (runBinding, verifiedGraphRevisionRef), GENESIS_AMOUNTS and the store-read budget identity (readGoalBudgetIdentity) — EVERYTHING EXCEPT the activation context; at activation, the same commitment is recomputed from activation's own reads and a mismatch REFUSES with an exact code+layer in the existing BOOTSTRAP_BUDGET_HASH_MISMATCH family before the root is minted; the root digest is then minted as today. The three ruling conditions are DoD-grade: (1) ONE shared canonical material builder feeds both the commitment and resolveApprovalBudgetRoot's record material (no second hand-maintained list); (2) consumer re-measure: `git grep -n budgetRef HEAD -- apps packages ':!*test*'` — graph-supersede-approval-binding.ts:73 (`record.budgetRef !== predecessor.boundHashes?.budgetHash` — a DIGEST comparison that must become commitment-vs-commitment or bind-back), expansion-approval.ts:227 / expansion-preparation.ts:83/:140/:242 (criteria.budgetRef), control-room approval-detail-plan.tsx:59 (display), demo seeds — each updated or proven unaffected; (3) the bind-back refusal gets its own arm + one-field drill.

FAMILY: approval.decide_intent seam (6646f888 DONE; ba102165 WORKING on the policy ref; 3b61860f STEP_UP). Sequenced after ba102165 lands readApprovalRecordFacts (this row fills the BUDGET_REF slot there).
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK first, in a row comment with `git rev-parse HEAD` quoted, greps unpiped with exit codes plus a positive control: task-ba1021652dcc4469bc4deb04a8e7d7d5 is DONE on disk AND `git grep -n 'readApprovalRecordFacts' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/planning/` EXIT 0 (the facts reader exists to fill); `git grep -n 'APPROVAL_INTENT_BUDGET_REF_UNAVAILABLE' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.ts` EXIT 0; budget-genesis-leg.ts:185 resolveApprovalBudgetRoot and approval-activation.ts:168-170 BOOTSTRAP_BUDGET_HASH_MISMATCH still present; NO commitment function exists (`git grep -n -i 'budgetCommitment' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src` EXIT 1 — EXIT 0 = adopt/verify/report duplicate). Ruling comment-87ad84c1 re-read and its three conditions quoted. Porcelain clean on budget-genesis-leg.ts, approval-activation.ts, graph-activation-service.ts, graph-supersede-approval-binding.ts and their tests; live ownership scan.

ONE SHARED MATERIAL BUILDER (ruling condition 1): a single canonical builder in apps/daemon/src/budget/ produces the decide-time budget material (goalRef, projectId, approvedRun binding + verifiedGraphRevisionRef, GENESIS_AMOUNTS, the store-read goal budget identity) and BOTH `budgetCommitmentDigest(material)` and `resolveApprovalBudgetRoot`'s record material consume it; a drill that changes one field in the builder reds BOTH the commitment arm and the existing root-digest arm; there is no second hand-maintained field list (grep asserted).

DECIDE TIME: readApprovalRecordFacts derives `budgetRef` = the commitment digest (64-hex, satisfies validHex64) from durable reads only — never from the payload; with the material unavailable it answers `missing: APPROVAL_INTENT_BUDGET_REF_UNAVAILABLE` with the source's code+layer as upstream; the seam's code/layer are unchanged.

ACTIVATION BINDS BACK (ruling condition 3): approval-activation.ts and graph-activation-service.ts recompute the commitment from their own reads BEFORE minting the root and REFUSE with an exact stable code in the BOOTSTRAP_BUDGET_HASH_MISMATCH family @ DAEMON_PREREQUISITE when the record's budgetRef disagrees; a matching commitment proceeds to mint root.digest exactly as today (existing arms green, unedited). Own arm + drill: mutate ONE committed field (e.g. verifiedGraphRevisionRef) on the record side -> the bind-back arm reds with that code+layer; divergence: the existing caller-claimed budgetHash fence stays green under that mutation.

CONSUMER RE-MEASURE (ruling condition 2): `git grep -n budgetRef HEAD -- apps packages ':!*test*'` enumerated at plan time; graph-supersede-approval-binding.ts:73 is updated to compare commitment-to-commitment (or to bind back through the same builder) with its arms re-anchored; expansion-approval.ts:227 / expansion-preparation.ts criteria.budgetRef are updated or PROVEN by arm to already carry the same commitment notion; approval-detail-plan.tsx display and demo seeds are updated or proven unaffected. Every consumer named in the completion comment with its disposition.

Mutation drills one degree of freedom each with restore proofs (SHA256 vs %TEMP% for uncommitted files); gates standalone, foreground, unpiped, exit 0 with nonzero counts: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` (quote `$ tsc`), focused daemon suites from apps/daemon (approval-intent, approval-activation, graph-activation-service, graph-supersede-approval-binding, budget-genesis-leg tests + the new module's) with `Test Files N passed`, `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` path-attributed; every production source <= 250 lines (split before 400, `.js` bridges); explicit-pathspec commit; completion comment references ruling comment-87ad84c1 and states: 'budgetRef is now a decide-time commitment over the shared material; activation binds back and refuses a mismatch'.
taskRails: Ruling (A) only: activation stays the mint; never move resolveApprovalBudgetRoot to decide time (B) and never drop budgetRef from the record (C) — both are attestation-changing and rejected outright.
One canonical material builder for the shared subset; the commitment function takes its output; two hand-maintained material lists are the digest-mirror drift this board's gotchas exist for.

Fail closed: a mismatched commitment at activation refuses with exact code+layer before any root mint; absence at decide time refuses APPROVAL_INTENT_BUDGET_REF_UNAVAILABLE; never a default digest, never caller-supplied.
Sequenced after task-ba102165 (owns readApprovalRecordFacts); consumer re-measure is mandatory at plan time — the ref changes meaning from digest to commitment.
Explicit-pathspec commits; foreign WIP preserved; <=250 lines per production source; TDD red-first through the production seams.
